identity.name: Journal of Science and Medicine in Sport
identity.source_note: Encoded from the live ScienceDirect guide via Apify rag-web-browser headless render (HTTP 200); WebFetch on the same URL returned 403. Published by Elsevier on behalf of Sports Medicine Australia. URL: https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-science-and-medicine-in-sport/publish/guide-for-authors

encoding_notes: Live current ScienceDirect page rendered headless (Apify rag-web-browser), HTTP 200; WebFetch 403'd. Source is TIER_A live content obtained via headless render.

Article-type mapping: Original Research->original_research; Review Articles (systematic/scoping reviews and meta-analyses ONLY)->systematic_review; 'Brief reports/Research Letters/Case Reports' is one category (1500w, 100w unstructured abstract, refs max 20, combined tables+figures max 2)->encoded as case_report; Letters-to-the-Editor->letter.

Omitted with no clean enum slot: Viewpoint (1500w, no abstract, refs max 10, combined tables+figures max 2), Consensus Statements & Clinical Practice Guidelines (~6000w, max 3 tables + 3 figures), Registered Reports (follows Original Research structure).
By-invitation-only types excluded from article_types (authors cannot freely submit): Narrative reviews (Cornerstone Reviews), Counterpoint/Rebuttal, Editorials.

SCHEMA GAP — combined table+figure caps not representable per-type: Original Research combined tables+figures max 6; Review combined max 6; Brief report/Case report combined max 2; Letter max one table OR figure (combined 1). Encoded figures_max/tables_max as null to avoid overstating individual caps.

SCHEMA GAP — tiered figure DPI: min 300 dpi for color/grayscale photographs (halftones), 1000 dpi for bitmapped line drawings, 500 dpi for combination line/halftone. Encoded min_dpi=300 (photograph floor); higher tiers apply to line art.

abstract.structured/sections/max_words reflect the primary type (Original Research): structured 250-word abstract with Objectives, Design, Methods, Results, Conclusions. Review adds a Discussion heading (Objectives, Design, Method, Results, Discussion, Conclusions), also <=250w. Case/Brief report abstract is <=100 words and UNSTRUCTURED. Viewpoint and Letters have NO abstract.
Keywords: 'up to 6 keywords, with at least 4 selected via MeSH'; encoded min 4 / max 6. Keywords must not reproduce title words. Keyword case/separator not specified -> null.

line_numbers: guide requires page AND line numbers 'for the convenience of the peer reviewers' but does not specify continuous vs per-page; encoded 'continuous' (standard default) as the enum has no null option — treat as low-confidence.

references.style: guide states 'no strict requirements on reference formatting at submission' (journal applies its style at proof); the worked example (Hanna CM, Fulcher ML, Elley CR et al. ... J Sci Med Sport 2010; 13(3):299-303) is numbered Vancouver with NLM journal-title abbreviations, so encoded style=vancouver, journal_abbrev=nlm, order=cited.
references.in_text: guide says cite references in numeric order by order of mention but does NOT specify superscript vs bracket vs parenthetical -> null (unstated).
et_al_threshold=3: 'All authors should be listed where there are three or fewer. Where there are more than three, the reference should be to the first three authors followed by et al.'
include_doi=true: 'Use of DOI is highly encouraged' (encouraged, not strictly mandatory).

tables.placement: JSAMS manuscript structure says tables 'may be submitted at the end of the text file, on separate pages, one to each page' -> grouped_end; note the generic Elsevier Tables subsection says 'Tables must be placed next to the relevant text' (in_text) — conflict, chose the JSAMS-specific instruction. Caption position not explicitly stated (notes go below the table body); table numbering consecutive arabic.

figures.legends_location=figure_legends_section: 'Figure Legends must be submitted as part of the text file and not as illustrations'; figures themselves are separate files. figure formats listed: EPS/PDF (vector), TIFF/JPEG (photographs/line art); PNG not listed. callout_style and naming_pattern not prescribed for main text -> null (appendix uses 'Fig. A.1').

declarations: Acknowledgments section is compulsory (contains funding + conflict-of-interest declarations) and sits before References; a 'Declaration of Generative AI and AI-assisted technologies' section is required before the reference list (no enum slot). Declaration of interest / competing-interests statement required even if none. Funding statement required (mandated 'no external financial support' sentence if none). Ethics approval statement required for human studies (in Methods). Conditional/not encoded as always-required: patient_consent (if patient details/images), trial_registration (clinical trials, number preferably at end of abstract), author_contributions (required when >7 authors). Data statement encouraged, not mandatory.

layout margins stated as '1 inch or 2.5 cm all around'; encoded 25.4 mm (1 inch canonical). page_size not stated -> null. alignment=left inferred from explicit 'do not use the word processor's options to justify text'. Manuscript double-spaced throughout including title page, abstract, text, references, tables, legends.

orcid_required=false: ORCID not mentioned as required in this guide. cover_letter_required=true: every submission must include a cover letter stating article category and sub-discipline. highlights_required=false: Elsevier Highlights not required; optional 'Practical Implications' (3-5 bullet points) is a JSAMS-specific non-mandatory feature.

Decision on initial submission expected within ~8 weeks. Submission via Editorial Manager (editorialmanager.com/JSAMS). 'Your Paper Your Way' allows a single free-format Word/PDF at initial submission; full JSAMS formatting required only at revision.
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'bracket' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'vancouver').
